graph.name: EARTH2 hard pass: responses, supply and late dominoes
graph.schema: Graphify v5 (NetworkX node-link: nodes and links)
graph.origin: hard pass Nov 25 (A to about B, estimate)
graph.strength_rule: strength = (odds of B if A fires - odds of B now) / (100 - odds of A now), absolute value, capped at 1. Scheduled nodes at 97 or more carry a flat 0.1 to 0.3 estimate.
graph.not_advice: Not financial advice. No tickets, no orders.
graph.note: All odds are first estimates from the Nov 25 hard pass and are flagged estimated. No existing node's odds were changed.

nodes.label: IPO share supply wave: SpaceX releases 797.6M locked shares on Dec 8, 2026 (its IPO float was 555.6M); Anthropic releases 303M on Dec 15, 303M on Jan 5, 353M on Jan 19 and 353M on Feb 2. True if the releases happen on schedule.
nodes.least_capability: Nothing. The dates are in the IPO terms.
nodes.source: StockCar Nov 21, 2026; FinanceFeeds Nov 25, 2026 (secondary; verify in the filings)

nodes.label: Year-end funding squeeze: on any day from Dec 15, 2026 to Jan 5, 2027 the overnight secured rate (SOFR) prints 25 bp or more above the Fed's interest on reserves, or Standing Repo Facility use tops $75B.
nodes.least_capability: Year-end balance-sheet dates with reserves near scarce and the Fed not buying bills.
nodes.source: NY Fed Nov 24, 2026 (SOFR 3.94% vs 3.90%); Goldman Nov 10, 2026 (reserves near scarcity)

nodes.label: Survival financing: a neocloud or miner-host under stress closes a lifeline of $1B or more from a customer or supplier (backed loan, prepayment, equity or takeover). First test: CoreWeave's $4B Meta-backed loan, marketed since Nov 16, and about $9B of expected customer prepayments.
nodes.least_capability: A customer that needs the capacity more than it fears the credit.

nodes.label: OpenAI cuts, defers or renegotiates a compute commitment of $10B or more, or a supplier (Oracle, CoreWeave, Microsoft, AMD, Broadcom) discloses it. A fall in Oracle's contracted backlog from one quarter to the next counts.
nodes.least_capability: A closed IPO window. No failure is needed, only a slower raise.

nodes.label: Oracle defends its rating: it sells $10B or more of new stock or equity-linked paper, or cuts its fiscal 2027 capex guide. It has already sold out a $20B at-the-market program and raised $10B of stock plus $10B of notes in early November.
nodes.least_capability: A rating one notch above junk at S&P (trigger: debt at 4.5 times earnings).
nodes.source: Oracle 10-Q for Aug 31, 2026; DCD early Nov 2026; S&P Jul 9, 2026

nodes.label: Flight to quality: the 10-year Treasury closes below 4.50% (4.83% on Nov 25, down from 5.05% on Nov 19).
nodes.least_capability: Stocks and credit doing the Fed's tightening for it; gasoline down 56 cents in November.

nodes.label: The credit index catches down: the US high-yield bond spread (ICE BofA) closes at 500 bp or more (364 bp on Nov 24, while CoreWeave's default insurance is 1,314 bp and a $500M data-center loan auction failed).
nodes.least_capability: One large default or one failed financing. The index is priced for neither.
nodes.source: Saxo Nov 24, 2026; ICE via Korea Invest Insights Nov 20, 2026; Roic Nov 25, 2026
nodes.next_watch: Dec 1 BCRED window; CoreWeave loan; Jan 14 bank results

nodes.label: The lenders who felt safe: a US life insurer or annuity writer discloses $1B or more of private-credit or AI data-center losses, is downgraded for them, or a private-equity-owned insurer is seized or halts withdrawals.
nodes.least_capability: Year-end audited marks on private assets.
nodes.source: Royal Gazette Nov 11, 2026 (Bermuda life sector $435.7B); NAIC Nov 17, 2026; hard pass estimate

nodes.label: Europe's gas wall: by Mar 31, 2027 EU storage falls below 15% full, or Dutch TTF gas settles above EUR 150/MWh, or a large member state declares a gas emergency, or the EU suspends its Jan 1 ban on long-term Russian LNG. Storage was 68.9% on Nov 23 against an 89% five-year average; TTF about EUR 90; Qatar loading about half its pre-war volume.
nodes.least_capability: A normal winter. The storage arithmetic does the rest.
nodes.source: GIE via PiQ Markets Nov 23 to 24, 2026; IEA via S&P Global Nov 3, 2026; Bloomberg Nov 10, 2026
nodes.next_watch: Jan 1 Russian LNG ban; weekly storage

nodes.label: Democrats take both chambers of Congress on Jan 3, 2027 (Senate 56 to 44; House at least 231, final count unverified).
Divided government bites: a federal shutdown of 5 days or more begins between Dec 12, 2026 and Jun 30, 2027 (funding expires Dec 11; the Iran campaign is funded through January).
nodes.least_capability: A stopgap that expires under the new Congress.
nodes.source: Kalshi about Nov 25, 2026 (27% for Dec 11); The National Nov 25, 2026

nodes.label: The Fed stops: no hike at two straight meetings after Dec 9, or the statement drops its lean toward tightening. First chance Jan 27, then Mar 17.
nodes.least_capability: A credit market that tightens on its own, or a shutdown that blanks the data.

nodes.label: Layoffs find their reason: a Fortune 100 company announces 5,000 or more job cuts and names AI as a cause while the S&P 500 sits 8% or more below its record.
nodes.least_capability: A falling share price. AI is the reason investors reward.
nodes.source: Hard pass Nov 25, 2026 (estimate); routine job losses cluster in downturns
nodes.next_watch: January announcements; Challenger report early February

nodes.label: The Ellison complex cracks: Skydance (SKYD; about $86.8B of debt, rated BB) announces a distressed exchange or a forced asset sale of $5B or more, or Larry Ellison sells, or adds to, the 413M Oracle shares he has pledged for personal loans.
nodes.least_capability: Oracle's share price. It backs all three: the pledge, the guarantee and the company.
nodes.source: Oracle proxy Sep 21, 2026; Skydance 10-Q; The DESK Nov 10, 2026

nodes.label: Nvidia's quarterly report, due Dec 4, is filed late or discloses a formal SEC investigation, a subpoena or a material weakness.
nodes.least_capability: A lawyer's caution after the chief executive resigned (Nov 11) and returned (Nov 23).

nodes.label: Bitcoin's forced seller: Strategy (851,305 BTC bought at $75,446 on average; its stock is worth about 63% of its bitcoin) sells 10,000 or more BTC in a month or suspends a preferred dividend. MSCI drops the stock on Nov 30.
nodes.least_capability: Bitcoin staying under its cost while the stock trades below the coins.
